label: sec:beta-decay-mechanism-hadron-half-life-preamble
html: Sorting \beta-emitters by their skein transition topology partitions the observed lifetimes into discrete structural regimes. This section classifies the hadron half-life regimes, derives the leading-order electroweak vacuum factor N_V = 120\,q_0^{90} from the S_5 Bring action at brane-tower depth 90, presents a worked per-shell half-life evaluation across {}^3\mathrm{H} and {}^{14}\mathrm{C}, and completes the symbolic audit of the tritium \beta-decay endpoint.
